description: Read-only revalidation of the historical E7 improved-T4 snapshot against the current production branch with the fail-closed checker (wc1.t3_audit.check_improved_snapshot). This is NOT a new snapshot: stale records need a fresh full wc1.t3_audit run (the E7 source report.json was not retained), and the snapshot is not consumed by Wave 4B. Since 61470fa a record must embed its OMF summary and an audit-time symbol stamp to be fully fresh; the E7 records predate both, so the non-stale ones are 'partial' (symbol_coverage and record_integrity unchecked; the snapshot's snapshot_integrity and record_set_integrity are unchecked) and every record needs regeneration before any use.
